A typical day of one sensor

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_average_day.Rd

For each hour of the day, the median of the hourly averages over all the days (the line), and the middle half of the days, between the 25th and 75th percentiles (the band): a narrow band means that hour is much the same every day.

Usage

plot_average_day(hourly, variable, unit = "", mode = "light")

Arguments

hourly

Data frame from get_hourly().

variable

Name of the sensor, for the title and the hover labels.

unit

Unit of the readings, "" for none.

mode

"light" or "dark", the mode of the app.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

hourly <- expand.grid(hour = 0:23, date = as.Date("2026-10-01") + 0:13)
hourly$value <- 21 + 2 * sin((hourly$hour - 9) / 24 * 2 * pi) + rnorm(nrow(hourly), sd = 0.5)
plot_average_day(hourly, "Temperature", "C")


url <- "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range"
plot_average_day(get_hourly(url, "humidity", days = 30), "Humidity", "%")
